raw.query: SELECT window_name, lead_s, sla_metric, p99_ms, run_id FROM v_pool_latency WHERE pool = 'language' AND sla_metric = 'ttft' AND run_id IN ('riders:fc_lead60','riders:fc_lead90','riders:fc_lead120','riders:fc_lead300','planner:fc_burst1_tp2_s8') ORDER BY run_id
raw.observed: riders:fc_lead60=736.25, fc_lead90=744.25, fc_lead120=757.17, fc_lead300=757.18; instant planner:fc_burst1_tp2_s8=751.24
raw.claimed: TTFT p99 736-757 ms (forecast+lead) vs 751 ms (instant); passes at every lead
raw.evidence: Range 736-757 matches data exactly, and baseline 751 matches planner:fc_burst1_tp2_s8=751.24. But at leads 120s (757.17) and 300s (757.18) the forecast policy p99 exceeds the instant baseline by ~6ms, contradicting 'passes at every lead'. Moreover only 4 discrete leads (60/90/120/300) were tested, not 'every' lead in 60-300s.
raw.fix: EITHER widen range to ~736-757.2 and note leads 120-300 slightly overshoot the instant baseline, OR use 'at the tested leads 60-300s the policy matches instant-worker p99 within <1%'
